svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 350 x 300 mm with a 90 x 90 mm tab centred above and below:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 480 mm tall overall. Round the outside corners to about 5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights from the bottom edge of the lower tab; sideways from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line. The plate-holes picture repeats every position.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saddle bolts: four 9 mm holes on the centre line, 10 and 50 mm up,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 430 and 470 mm up (one pair in each tab).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lug screws: four 5.5 mm holes 142 mm each side, 100 and 380 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shield screws: drill 4.2 mm and tap M5, 164.5 mm each side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the back face bolts flat on two saddles with four M8 bolts from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front; the enclosure hangs on its front by the four lugs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay a saddle on each tab and look through the holes.
